diagnosis.overview: The agent consistently falls back to hallucinated approximations and internal arithmetic when facing tool errors or complex data, instead of robustly retrieving and computing precise values from source files.
diagnosis.root_cause: The agent consistently falls back to hallucinated approximations and internal arithmetic when facing tool errors or complex data, instead of robustly retrieving and computing precise values from source files.
diagnosis.general_mechanism: 1. Add a system prompt rule: 'All quantitative data extraction and calculations must be performed by executing Python code; never guess or use mental arithmetic. If a tool fails, retry or use an alternative code-based approach, and never submit an answer without successful verification.' 2. Ensure a Python code interpreter tool is bound in agent.yaml for all numeric and data-retrieval tasks. 3. Implement middleware to block final answer delivery if any tool call ended in error without a confirmed successful retry, forcing the agent to resolve or explicitly mark the task as incomplete.
